verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms a public REST API (products, sales, subscribers, licenses) and an OAuth + MCP integration. Nothing in the pack documents API versioning or a deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI and api.md probes returned 404. The axis applies to a commerce platform with a public API, so the absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
